dataset.name: Polish electronic toll (e-TOLL)
dataset.method: Rozporządzenie Rady Ministrów z dnia 8 stycznia 2026 r. (Dz. U. 2026 poz. 33), amending the regulation of 22 March 2011 on national roads subject to the electronic toll and its rates; Annexes 3 (class A and S roads) and 4 (class GP and G roads), in force 1 February 2026. Rates by permissible total mass (with trailer: over 3.5 t and under 12 t; 12 t or more) and EURO class (max. EURO 2, EURO 3, EURO 4, min. EURO 5); no CO2 component.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: Dz. U. 2026 poz. 33 (e-TOLL network and rates from 1 February 2026)
KAS: changes in e-TOLL from 1 February 2026

vehicles.description: Motor vehicles and combinations over 3.5 t permissible total mass (with trailer), and buses

network.description: e-TOLL sections of national roads: motorways and expressways (class A, S) and main roads (GP, G), about 5,870 km. Not included: the concession motorway sections (A1 Rusocin-Toruń, A2 Świecko-Konin, A4 Katowice-Kraków), charged by their operators.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
